title: Publish and Back to draft keep the deployment's zone in the site's frame-ancestors: with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site and no FLEET_ZONE, go-live.sh writes https://*.tracy.site, not https://*.tracy.ai
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/go-live-fleet-zone.test.mjs (go-live.sh runs from a scratch copy of provision/ + lib/, with docker, iptables, netfilter-persistent and ingress_api.py stubbed; nothing on the machine is touched)
S2: Read the ok/not ok line of each named test.
expect: live with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site and no FLEET_ZONE: apache/tracy-noindex.conf carries frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.tracy.site and no tracy.ai, plus the TRACY_ORIGIN https://cowork.tracy.site.
draft with the same environment: the same frame-ancestors line.
FLEET_ZONE=tracy.ai with SITE_DOMAIN=tracy.site: https://*.tracy.ai (FLEET_ZONE wins, as in provision.sh).
go-live.sh reads FLEET_ZONE="${FLEET_ZONE:-${SITE_DOMAIN:-tracy.ai}}" before its first tracy_write_apache_conf call.
evidence: Measured 22/10/2026 on the dev host (zone tracy.site): the fresh draft hihehihe.tracy.site sent frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.tracy.site ... https://cowork.tracy.site; the published demos ja-diner-wordpress, ja-vega-joomla and base-joomla .tracy.site sent https://*.tracy.ai, so a shard origin (https://s1.tracy.site) could not frame them in the template gallery.
fence: go-live.sh itself on the noindex step with stubbed docker/iptables. Not exercised: Apache reloading the conf in a real site container.

tests: live: SITE_DOMAIN alone names the zone
draft: SITE_DOMAIN alone names the zone
neither set: the zone falls back to tracy.ai
